simple.meaning: אֶצְבַּע (ʼetsbaʻ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “finger, toe.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H677. etsba [ אֶצְבַּע ] noun feminine 1 finger ; 2 toe ( ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew id. ); — plural 1 absolute אֶצְבְּעָן Dan 5:5 . 2 emph תָָ֯א 2:41 ; construct עָ֯ 2:42 .

occurrences.englishText: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.
As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom will be partly strong, and partly broken.
In the same hour, the fingers of a man’s hand came out and wrote near the lamp stand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace. The king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
